purpose: The engine versions a validation result is measured against (faculty, 2026-09-28, cycle 5, §13, §44, §51). A baseline is never replaced retroactively: a new one is added. A run records its engine commit; the report names the baseline that commit is, from this registry, and the version of the known-defects list its errors are tagged against. A commit read with uncommitted changes is no baseline.

baselines.name: SPANISH PILOT BASELINE
baselines.use: The Spanish physicians' documents are measured against this commit first, before any change to the engine.
